services.name: Circle Farm Tour
services.desc: With rich, fertile soil and a temperate climate, the Harrison River Valley naturally has a deep-rooted history in agriculture. Follow the winding country roads to explore hands-on experiences, craft cideries, farm-to-table dining, artisanal goods, and more on the self-guided Agassiz-Harrison Circle Farm Tour. So, what is a Circle Farm Tour? It’s a self-guided journey through the region’s rich agricultural landscape - where you can meet friendly farm animals, connect with local growers and makers, and savour fresh flavours straight from the source.
